# Aegis-JKN Agent Wiki Index

## Overview

## Concepts

- [Fraud Rings & Collusion Communities](concepts/fraud-rings.md): Collusive community detection and drilldown audit
- [SHAP Camouflage Detection](concepts/shap-camouflage-detection.md): Explainable AI for adversarial camouflage fraud
- [Dataset Contract](concepts/dataset-contract.md): Canonical synthetic 300-claim source, SHA-256 baseline, and absent fields
